comment_text.value:
My grandmother and her cat build a dictation app. There are so many out there and I really don't get it why anyone would still pay for Wispr Flow

I did one (it's free) and recent update brought it very close to Wispr on local models only: https://dictator.work

story_title.value: Show HN: BetterWispr – Free, open-source dictation for Mac
